## Variant: fp32-b16 {#variant-fp32-b16}

<span class="badge status-systems-only">systems-only</span>

> Characterizes fp32 LLM decode bandwidth and dispatch behavior with random weights; useful for architecture studies but not quality-bearing.

### At a Glance

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Suite** | language |
| **Model** | nanogpt-small-86m |
| **Parameters** | 88.3M |
| **Dataset** | prompt-suite-local |
| **Dataset source** | Deterministic local token prompts embedded in the runner; no external evaluation dataset required. |
| **Scenario** | server |
| **Maturity** | research |
| **Public status** | systems-only |
| **Provenance** | Iter-6 (Han): GPT-2-Small geometry decode at fp32. Real-LLM stand-in used to populate the bandwidth-bound serving-regime cells. Random weights for roofline characterization; iter-6.5 will train on TinyShakespeare. |

### How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
mlperf fetch --workload nanogpt-inference --variant fp32-b16 --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
mlperf run --workload nanogpt-inference --variant fp32-b16 --profile max --open-report

# quick smoke pass
mlperf run --workload nanogpt-inference --variant fp32-b16 --profile min

# research envelope
mlperf run --workload nanogpt-inference --variant fp32-b16 --profile pro
```

See the [running guide](../../guide/running.qmd) for profile semantics, report handling, and power measurement flags.

## Variant: speculative {#variant-speculative}

<span class="badge status-systems-only">systems-only</span>

> Teaches speculative decoding mechanics and acceptance-rate tradeoffs, but uses a scaffolded target/draft pair rather than a canonical trained model.

### At a Glance

| **Field** | **Value** |
|:---|:---|
| **Suite** | language |
| **Model** | nanogpt-small-86m |
| **Parameters** | 88.3M |
| **Dataset** | prompt-suite-local |
| **Dataset source** | Deterministic local token prompts embedded in the runner; no external evaluation dataset required. |
| **Scenario** | server |
| **Maturity** | research |
| **Public status** | systems-only |
| **Provenance** | Iter-6 (Han): speculative decoding with 11M draft + 88M target, gamma=4, lossless argmax verify. Pedagogical demonstration that speculation only helps when draft and target agree often (random-init scaffold here gets 0% acceptance and is therefore SLOWER than baseline -- the lesson is that the draft must be trained to mimic the target distribution). |

### How to Run

```bash
# one-time asset preparation
mlperf fetch --workload nanogpt-inference --variant speculative --profile max

# benchmark run (writes JSON/HTML/CSV reports + .provd provenance)
mlperf run --workload nanogpt-inference --variant speculative --profile max --open-report

# quick smoke pass
mlperf run --workload nanogpt-inference --variant speculative --profile min

# research envelope
mlperf run --workload nanogpt-inference --variant speculative --profile pro
```

<span class="badge status-performance-bearing">performance-bearing</span>

| **Scenario** | server |
| **Maturity** | base |
| **Public status** | performance-bearing |
| **Provenance** | GPT-2 autoregressive decode; the regime that dominates LLM serving cost in production (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, TGI all built around this) |
